task.title: Add greenfield support to festina-create-project
task.description: Enhance /festina-create-project to detect greenfield projects (no product docs, no engineering docs, no/minimal codebase) and activate an enhanced flow: adaptive vision capture with 2-4 broad questions, GSD-style parallel research agents (stack, features, architecture, pitfalls), AI-proposed versioned requirements (v1 MVP / v2 future / out-of-scope), and decomposition from v1 requirements only. Also removes the unused /festina-define skill entirely.
task.problem: festina-create-project assumes an existing codebase with product and engineering docs. For greenfield projects (no code, no docs, no tasks), users have no viable path. festina-define exists but is too tedious — it asks 30-50 granular questions and produces temporary docs (Intent/Requirements/Boundaries) that get rewritten during finalize. Users end up not using festinalente for new projects at all.
task.value: Users can reliably go from "I have an idea" to structured, scoped tasks using a single /festina-create-project invocation — with AI-driven research (stack, architecture, patterns, pitfalls) filling the knowledge gap that an existing codebase would normally provide. This makes festinalente a complete tool for both greenfield and brownfield projects.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given a user runs /festina-create-project with no existing product/engineering docs (greenfield detected) When vision capture asks 2-4 broad questions: what are you building, what tech (or "unsure"), what's MVP/out-of-scope, anything else (skippable) Then 4 parallel research agents always run: stack, features, architecture, and pitfalls And the AI proposes requirements versioned as v1 (MVP) / v2 (future) / out-of-scope And the user validates and the project is decomposed into 2-5 tasks from v1 requirements only
Given research agents complete When the user said "unsure" about tech choices Then the stack agent proposes options with pros/cons and the user validates And when the user already specified tech preferences Then the stack agent still researches but validates/augments the user's choice rather than replacing it
Given research findings are produced Then they are stored in a <research> section in project.xml And they carry through to /festina-scope and /festina-plan as context for downstream skills
Given a user runs /festina-create-project with existing product/engineering docs Then the existing flow works unchanged (no regression)
Given a user cancels during vision capture Q&A Then no project or task files are created And no partial state is left behind
Given a research agent fails or returns no results Then the flow continues with remaining agent results And the user is informed which research was unavailable
Given the user provides very minimal input (just a title, skips all questions) Then the AI uses judgment to propose requirements based on the title alone And marks all requirements as inferred
Given this task is complete Then the festina-define skill is removed from source (apps/festinalente/src/content/skills/festina-define/) and installed (.claude/skills/festina-define/) And its product doc (skills/define-product) is removed And its directive mapping is removed from .festinalente/config.yaml And the G-DEFPROD rule is removed from the git directive (.festinalente/directives/git.xml)
task.notes:
**Research references:** - Research: GSD (get-shit-done, 40K GitHub stars) — "dream extraction" questioning, 4 parallel researcher agents (stack, features, architecture, pitfalls), phased roadmap, auto mode - Research: Taskmaster (claude-task-master, 26K stars) — PRD-first approach, simpler but requires user-written PRD - Research: BMAD Method (42K stars) — 12+ agent personas, heavyweight agile framework - User: GSD's parallel research phase is the strongest model for greenfield — adopted for this task
**Design principles:** - User: "I know what I want to build roughly and know what tech I want to use" — research should augment, not interrogate - User: AI proposes everything, user validates — "You decide" as default posture - User: No extra files or artifacts — research stored in project.xml, not separate files - User: User can cancel Q&A at any time — graceful exit with no partial state - User: festina-define should be killed entirely, not preserved as optional
